instruction: Prepare the trainer's setup-photo handoff. On the first phone, take a new photo with Camera, then use Simple Gallery Pro to rename that new photo to `training_setup_photo.jpg`. The trainer contact on the second phone supplies the recipient address. Read the purpose and package reference from `/tmp/train/handoff.txt` on the first Linux machine. On the second Linux machine, complete its local `/tmp/train/template.odp` with the photo filename, trainer email, purpose, and reference; save it as `/tmp/train/deck.odp` and export `/tmp/train/training_deck.pdf`. Leave an unsent Thunderbird draft to the trainer with that PDF attached, mentioning both `training_deck.pdf` and the package reference.

parameters.command: mkdir -p /sdcard/DCIM/Camera; rm -f /sdcard/DCIM/Camera/training_setup_photo.jpg /sdcard/DCIM/Camera/.mdcbench_l027_started; content delete --uri content://media/external/images/media --where "_display_name='training_setup_photo.jpg' AND relative_path='DCIM/Camera/'" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; touch /sdcard/DCIM/Camera/.mdcbench_l027_started
test -s /tmp/train/handoff.txt && grep -Fq 'Purpose: Training setup photo' /tmp/train/handoff.txt && grep -Fq 'Package reference: TRN-417' /tmp/train/handoff.txt

rm -f /sdcard/DCIM/Camera/training_setup_photo.jpg /sdcard/DCIM/Camera/.mdcbench_l027_started; content delete --uri content://media/external/images/media --where "_display_name='training_setup_photo.jpg' AND relative_path='DCIM/Camera/'" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

metadata.surfaces: Camera/Simple Gallery Pro + Contacts + Impress + Thunderbird
metadata.setup_note: android_0 准备 Camera 与 Simple Gallery Pro，并用临时 Camera media 通过 Gallery Rename 对话框预检改名路径后清理 probe、定向清理目标照片；android_1 写 Trainer 联系人；linux_0 只提供含 purpose/TRN-417 的 handoff；linux_1 本地预置真实 ODP template、重建 exact Thunderbird profile 并准备输出目录。
metadata.evaluate_note: 检查可解码的新 JPEG、保留一页/一框/五段模板结构且四个字段关系正确的 ODP、含相同字段的真实 PDF，以及 exact profile 中至少一封同时识别 training_deck.pdf 与 TRN-417、附加当前导出 PDF 且目标邮件未出现在 Sent 的草稿。
